value.query: WITH MIGRN_MIN_IMS_WEEK_DATE_CTE AS (SELECT DATEADD(WEEK, -109, MAX(IMS_WEEK_DATE)) AS MIGRN_MIN_IMS_WEEK_DATE_UDM FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({MIGRN_DSP_NAME_1}, {MIGRN_DSP_NAME_2})), RETAIL_SALES_CTE AS ( SELECT RX.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, RX.IMS_NUMBER, RX.ABV_PRODUCT_ID, RX.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME, MDM.PRODUCT_NAME, CUST.DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG AS CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, CUST.PRESCRIBER_FLAG, RX.MARKET_ID, RX.IMS_WEEK_DATE, RX.TOTAL_RX_COUNT, RX.REFILL_RX_COUNT, RX.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, IMS_NUMBER, ABV_PRODUCT_ID, MARKET_ID, DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME, IMS_WEEK_DATE, SUM(TOTAL_RX_COUNT) AS TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS REFILL_RX_COUNT, SUM(TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT FROM {SCHEMA_SALES}.{SRC_UDM_RX_RETAIL_THIN_WEEKLY} WHERE MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND IMS_WEEK_DATE >= (SELECT * FROM MIGRN_MIN_IMS_WEEK_DATE_CTE) GROUP BY ALL ) RX INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG, PRESCRIBER_FLAG FROM {SCHEMA_DIM}.{SRC_CUST_VW} WHERE UPPER(TRIM(DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG))={ACTIVE_FLAG} ) CUST ON RX.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID=CUST.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_NAME, ABV_PRODUCT_ID FROM {SCHEMA_DIM}.{SRC_PROD_VW} WHERE UPPER(TRIM(DDS_ACTIVE_FLAG))={ACTIVE_FLAG} ) MDM ON RX.ABV_PRODUCT_ID=CAST(MDM.ABV_PRODUCT_ID AS VARCHAR) ), INDICATIONS AS ( SELECT {MIGRN_IND_CODE_1} AS INDICATION UNION ALL SELECT {MIGRN_IND_CODE_2} AS INDICATION), PRIORITIZED_MAPPING AS ( SELECT PRODUCT_NAME, PRODUCT, PRODUCT_PATTERN, PRIORITY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY PRIORITY) AS RN FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT R.PRODUCT_NAME, TRIM(M.PRODUCT) AS PRODUCT, TRIM(M.PRODUCT_PATTERN) AS PRODUCT_PATTERN, M.PRIORITY FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R JOIN {SCHEMA_FFP_NEURO}.{SRC_PRD_MAPP} M ON UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE TRIM(UPPER(M.PRODUCT_PATTERN)) WHERE R.MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({MIGRN_DSP_NAME_1},{MIGRN_DSP_NAME_2}) ) sub ), SOURCE_DATA AS ( SELECT CAST(R.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID AS STRING) AS ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, R.IMS_WEEK_DATE AS WEEK_DATE, CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(MPG.MARKET)) = {MKT_PREVENTIVE} THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_2} WHEN UPPER(TRIM(MPG.MARKET)) = {MKT_ACUTE} THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_1} WHEN UPPER(TRIM(MPG.MARKET)) = {MKT_TOTAL} THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} ELSE {MIGRN_IND_CODE_3} END AS INDICATION, COALESCE(M.PRODUCT, {INVALID_CHARACTER_3}) AS PRODUCT, R.CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG AS SALES_CUSTOMER_ACTIVE_FLAG, R.PRESCRIBER_FLAG AS SALES_PRESCRIBER_FLAG, SUM( CASE WHEN R.MARKET_ID = {MIGRN_MKT_ID_1} OR (R.MARKET_ID = {MIGRN_MKT_ID_2} AND ( UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_1} || '%') OR UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_2} || '%') OR UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_3} || '%') OR UPPER(R.PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {PROD_EXC_4} || '%') )) THEN R.TOTAL_RX_COUNT ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END ) AS SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT, SUM(R.TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT) AS SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT, SUM(R.REFILL_RX_COUNT) AS SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT FROM RETAIL_SALES_CTE R LEFT JOIN PRIORITIZED_MAPPING M ON R.PRODUCT_NAME = M.PRODUCT_NAME AND M.RN = {DEFAULT_UNIT} LEFT JOIN {SCHEMA_FFP_NEURO}.{SRC_MIG_PRD_GRP} MPG ON UPPER(M.PRODUCT) = UPPER(TRIM(MPG.PRODUCT)) WHERE R.MARKET_ID IN ({MIGRN_MKT_ID_1},{MIGRN_MKT_ID_2}) AND R.DATA_SOURCE_PROVIDER_NAME IN ({MIGRN_DSP_NAME_1},{MIGRN_DSP_NAME_2}) AND M.PRODUCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6 ) SELECT SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.WEEK_DATE, CASE WHEN SRC.INDICATION = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN IND.INDICATION ELSE SRC.INDICATION END AS INDICATION_CODE, SRC.PRODUCT AS BRAND_NAME, CASE WHEN SUM(SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING} PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) > {FALLBACK_VALUE} THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE NULL END AS SALES_WRITER_FLAG, CASE WHEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE) = {DEFAULT_UNIT} AND SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT > {FALLBACK_VALUE}) OR (SUM(SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING} PRECEDING AND {DEFAULT_UNIT} PRECEDING) = {FALLBACK_VALUE} AND SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT > {FALLBACK_VALUE}) THEN {NEW_WRITER} WHEN SUM(SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY SRC.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, SRC.INDICATION, SRC.PRODUCT ORDER BY SRC.WEEK_DATE ROWS BETWEEN {WEEKS_PRECEDING} PRECEDING AND {DEFAULT_UNIT} PRECEDING) > {FALLBACK_VALUE} AND SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT >= {FALLBACK_VALUE} THEN {CONTINUOUS_WRITER} ELSE NULL END AS SALES_NEW_VS_CONTINUOUS_WRITER, CASE WHEN UPPER(SRC.INDICATION) = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN SRC.SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT/2 ELSE SRC.SALES_TOTAL_NORMALIZED_COUNT END AS SALES_NORMALIZED_TRX, CASE WHEN UPPER(SRC.INDICATION) = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN SRC.SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT/2 ELSE SRC.SALES_TOTAL_RX_COUNT END AS SALES_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX, CASE WHEN UPPER(SRC.INDICATION) = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4} THEN SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT/2 ELSE SRC.SALES_REFILL_RX_COUNT END AS SALES_NBRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_TRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_NON_NORMALIZED_TRX, NULL AS SALES_CUSTOMIZED_NBRX, NULL AS ACUTE_DECILE, NULL AS PREVENTIVE_DECILE FROM SOURCE_DATA SRC LEFT JOIN INDICATIONS IND ON SRC.INDICATION = {MIGRN_IND_CODE_4}

SELECT COALESCE(MAIN.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID,LL.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID) AS ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, COALESCE(MAIN.WEEK_DATE,LL.WEEK_DATE) AS WEEK_DATE, COALESCE(MAIN.INDICATION, LL.INDICATION) AS INDICATION_CODE, COALESCE(MAIN.PRODUCT, LL.PRODUCT) AS BRAND_NAME, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_PRESCRIBER_STATUS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_PDE, LL.CALL_ACTIVITY_LUNCH_AND_LEARN, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_VIRTUAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_VIRTUAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_VIRTUAL_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_TELE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_TELE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_TELE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_LIVE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_LIVE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_LIVE_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_NON_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_NON_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_NON_ISA_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_P1_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_P2_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_P3_CALLS, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_PDE, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_PDE, MAIN.CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_PDE FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ACTIVITYWEEK AS WEEK_DATE, INDICATION, PRODUCT, PRESCRIBER_STATUS AS CALL_ACTIVITY_PRESCRIBER_STATUS, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, SUM(TOTAL_CALLS) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_CALLS, SUM(ACTIVITY) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_TOTAL_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG ={ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG ={ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG ={ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG <> {ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_NON_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG <> {ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_NON_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND ISA_CALL_FLAG <> {ACTIVE_FLAG} THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_NON_ISA_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) THEN ACTIVITY ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) THEN ACTIVITY ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) THEN ACTIVITY ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_PDE, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_VIRTUAL_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_VIRTUAL_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_VIRTUAL_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_TELE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_TELE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_TELE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_1}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM1_LIVE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_2}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM2_LIVE_CALLS, SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE) IN ({MIGRN_SALES_FORCE_CODE_3}) AND  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) IN ({INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE}) THEN TOTAL_CALLS ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END) AS  CALL_ACTIVITY_CNSM3_LIVE_CALLS, SUM(P1_CALLS) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_P1_CALLS, SUM(P2_CALLS) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_P2_CALLS, SUM(P3_CALLS) AS CALL_ACTIVITY_P3_CALLS FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(TO_DATE(DATA_DATE))<={FRIDAY_INDEX} AND DAYOFWEEK(TO_DATE(DATA_DATE))>={MONDAY_INDEX} THEN (DATEADD(DAY,{WEEKDAY_OFFSET},(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', TO_DATE(DATA_DATE))))) ELSE (DATEADD(DAY,{WEEKEND_OFFSET},(DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', TO_DATE(DATA_DATE))))) END AS ACTIVITYWEEK, INTERACTION_TYPE, ISA_CALL_FLAG, REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE, CASE WHEN (UPPER(DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {MIGRN_IND_1_PRD_NAME} || '%') OR UPPER(CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || {MIGRN_IND_1_PRD_NAME} || '%') THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_1} WHEN (UPPER(DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {MIGRN_IND_2_PRD_NAME} || '%') OR UPPER(CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || {MIGRN_IND_2_PRD_NAME} || '%') THEN {MIGRN_IND_CODE_2} END AS INDICATION, PRESCRIBER_STATUS, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, CASE WHEN (UPPER(DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {MIGRN_IND_1_PRD_NAME} || '%') OR UPPER(CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || {MIGRN_IND_1_PRD_NAME} || '%') THEN {MIGRN_IND_1_PRD_NAME} WHEN (UPPER(DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME) LIKE ('%' || {MIGRN_IND_2_PRD_NAME} || '%') OR UPPER(CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME) LIKE '%' || {MIGRN_IND_2_PRD_NAME} || '%') THEN {MIGRN_IND_2_PRD_NAME} END AS PRODUCT, SUM(ACTIVITY) AS ACTIVITY, COUNT(DISTINCT CALL_ID) AS TOTAL_CALLS, SUM(P1_CALLS) AS P1_CALLS, SUM(P2_CALLS) AS P2_CALLS, SUM(P3_CALLS) AS P3_CALLS FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, CALL_ID, INDICATION,RNM,CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME, DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME, REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE, PRESCRIBER_STATUS,CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, CASE WHEN UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) LIKE ('%' || {INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL} || '%') OR  UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) LIKE ('%' || {INTERACTION_TYPE_EMAIL} || '%') THEN {INTERACTION_TYPE_VIRTUAL} WHEN UPPER(INTERACTION_TYPE) LIKE  ('%' || {INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE} || '%') THEN {INTERACTION_TYPE_TELE} WHEN INTERACTION_TYPE IS NULL THEN {INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE} ELSE {INTERACTION_TYPE_LIVE} END AS INTERACTION_TYPE, DATA_DATE, CASE WHEN CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_COUNT > {FALLBACK_VALUE} AND CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG = {ACTIVE_FLAG} AND EXCLUDED_TILES IS NULL THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE {INACTIVE_FLAG} END AS ISA_CALL_FLAG, SUM ( CASE WHEN PRIORITY_CODE = {PRIORITY_CODE_1} THEN {ASSIGNED_CODE_1} WHEN PRIORITY_CODE = {PRIORITY_CODE_2} THEN {ASSIGNED_CODE_2} WHEN PRIORITY_CODE > {PRIORITY_CODE_2} THEN {ASSIGNED_CODE_3} ELSE {FALLBACK_VALUE} END ) AS ACTIVITY, COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN PRIORITY_CODE = {PRIORITY_CODE_1} THEN CALL_ID END ) AS P1_CALLS, COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN PRIORITY_CODE = {PRIORITY_CODE_2} THEN CALL_ID END ) AS P2_CALLS, COUNT (DISTINCT CASE WHEN PRIORITY_CODE > {PRIORITY_CODE_2} THEN CALL_ID END ) AS P3_CALLS FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID,CALL_ID,INDICATION,DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME,CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME,REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE,CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG,PRESCRIBER_STATUS,INTERACTION_TYPE,CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_COUNT,EXCLUDED_TILES,DATA_DATE,PRIORITY_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ABV_CUSTOMER_ID,REP_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, TO_DATE(DATA_DATE), CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME, INDICATION, DISPLAY_FRANCHISE_NAME ORDER BY PRIORITY_CODE, (CASE WHEN CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_COUNT > {FALLBACK_VALUE} AND CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG = {ACTIVE_FLAG} AND EXCLUDED_TILES IS NULL THEN {ACTIVE_FLAG} ELSE {INACTIVE_FLAG} END) DESC , INTERACTION_TYPE,CALL_ID) AS RNM FROM ( SELECT CAST( CASE WHEN TILE.ACCOUNT_TYPE_INDICATOR = {ACCOUNT_TYPE_INDICATOR_HCP} THEN COALESCE(CUST_MERGE_HIST.WINNER_ID, TILE.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ACCOUNT.CUSTOMER_NUMBER) WHEN TILE.ACCOUNT_TYPE_INDICATOR = {ACCOUNT_TYPE_INDICATOR_HCI} THEN COALESCE(DS_MERGE_HIST.WINNER_ID, TILE.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ACCOUNT.CUSTOMER_NUMBER) ELSE COALESCE(CUST_MERGE_HIST.WINNER_ID, DS_MERGE_HIST.WINNER_ID, TILE.ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ACCOUNT.CUSTOMER_NUMBER) END AS STRING ) ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, REP_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, CALL_ID, INDICATION, UPPER(TILE.DISPLAY_FRANCHISE_NAME) AS DISPLAY_FRANCHISE_NAME, CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME, DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME, REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE, PRESCRIBER_STATUS, PRIORITY_CODE, INTERACTION_TYPE, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_COUNT, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, EXCLUDED_TILES, ACTIVITY_DATE AS DATA_DATE FROM ( SELECT ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, CALL_ID, INDICATION,CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME, DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME, REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE, CAST(PRIORITY_CODE AS STRING) PRIORITY_CODE, INTERACTION_TYPE, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_COUNT, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, EXCLUDED_TILES, ACTIVITY_DATE, ABV_PRODUCT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID,ACCOUNT_TYPE_INDICATOR, DISPLAY_FRANCHISE_NAME, REP_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ACTIVITY_MONTH, ACTIVITY_DATE, CALL_DETAIL_PRODUCT_NAME, DISPLAY_BRAND_NAME, DISPLAY_FRANCHISE_NAME, INDICATION, BRANDED_UNBRANDED, CALL_ID, PARENT_CALL_ID, CALL_DETAIL_ID, ACCOUNT_RECORD_TYPE_NAME, ACCOUNT_TYPE_INDICATOR, REP_EMPLOYEE_NUMBER, REP_EMPLOYEE_UPI_NUMBER, REP_EMPLOYEE_FULL_NAME, REP_EMPLOYEE_SALES_FORCE_CODE, REP_EMPLOYEE_TERRITORY_NUMBER, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_COUNT, INTERACTION_TYPE, PRIORITY_CODE, DETAIL_TYPE_CODE, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKET_DETAIL_FLAG, DERIVED_PARENT_ID, DERIVED_IS_PARENT, DERIVED_CALL_TYPE, CALL_DURATION_MINUTES, ABV_BEST_SPECIALTY_APPROVED_IND, ADDRESS_LINE_1, ADDRESS_LINE_2, CITY, STATE, ZIP_CODE, ABV_PRODUCT_ID, VEEVA_KEY_MSG_DESC, VEEVA_KEY_MSG_ID, CALL_PRESENTATION_ID, CALL_PRESENTATION_NAME, PRESENTATION_SLIDE_ORDER, SPECIALTY_DESC, EXCLUDED_TILES, TERRITORY_NUMBER, TERRITORY, DISTRICT, REGION, ABV_ACCOUNT_ID_CHILD, ABV_ACCOUNT_ID_PARENT, UNIVERSE_NAME, TILE_PROMOMAT_ID, PRESENTATION_PROMOMAT_ID, SOURCE_ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, CALL_KEY_MSG_EXTERNAL_ID, PRESENTATION_SLIDE_VERSION_NUMBER, VEEVA_KEY_MSG_NUMBER, CLOSED_LOOP_MARKETING_ID, ACCOUNT_AFFILIATION_ID, ROLL_UP_ELIGIBLE_FLAG, HCP_ATTENDEE_FLAG, ATTENDEE_ROLE, ROLL_UP_ELIGIBLE_FLAG_MONTH, ASSOC_PRESCRIBER_ABV_CUSTOMER_ID, ASSOC_PRESCRIBER_CALL_PLAN_FLAG, ISA_CALL_FLAG, FIRST_REP_CALL_OF_DAY_FLAG, CALL_ACTIVITY_DETAIL_RANK, CALL_TYPE, CALL_DISPOSITION, TIME_ID, BX_PROGRAMMATIC_TRAINING_FLAG, REVISED_REP_TERRITORY_NUMBER, ACCOUNT_ID FROM {SCHEMA_PP}.{SRC_UDM_CALL_ACTIVITY} WHERE ACTIVITY_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), 'MM'),-24) AND ( ABV_BEST_SPECIALTY_APPROVED_IND IN ({BEST_SPECIALTY_IND_1}, {BEST_SPECIALTY_IND_2}) OR ATTENDEE_ROLE_APPROVED = {ACTIVE_FLAG} ) ) WHERE TO_DATE(ACTIVITY_DATE) >= (SELECT MIN(WEEK_DATE) FROM
